compatibility.note: Cross-binding: a permissions release names the exact model and profile identities it expects, so a permissions/model drift surfaces as a rejected activation instead of a wrong score.

on_expiry.note: Expiry never widens permission. Hard prohibitions keep binding and every other eligible request escalates to a technician instead of silently allowing or silently denying.

release_note: Baseline release cached by alice-pi-01 before the DDIL window.

transport_note: Wazuh distributes and timestamps this release. Authority for its contents is the issuer above, not the SIEM.
